name: pypi-requests-client-library
note: a normal HTTP-client library: a module makes an outbound requests.get in library code (not setup.py), the way thousands of real PyPI packages do. Ordinary network use, no exec, no install hook — must stay safe. This is the calibration guard that the shared behavioral engine does not false-block ordinary Python network code.

sourceFiles.setup.py:
from setuptools import setup

setup(
    name="weatherfetch",
    version="1.2.0",
    packages=["weatherfetch"],
    install_requires=["requests>=2.0"],
)
